author: salivan
text: Quasimodo is a kind of price formation that contains IT's psychology to shakeout retailers and grab some more orders after ENG of the left shoulder(after ENG we must ask if the target reach or not?)this is why i told that QM is not a pattern, it's not guarantee that after ENG price come back to the exact QM LVL, it depends always where the clear orders are? the only imminent thing in this price formation is this: QM in HTF zone with the HH/LL reacted(FO) to a true S/D zone(FL) work nicely.
